name: colocated-module-types
goal: Keep named types in sibling files across existing and generated code, with a durable audit guard

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Named interfaces and type aliases should live beside their owner in separate files; existing source and generator outputs currently mix declarations with runtime code.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing ecosystem audit cases never assert mixed-type rejection, and scaffold-category coverage never checks declaration placement. Extend both standardized scenarios without changing their existing assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable red 393798ba08 at b480452d8 reproduces missing audit rejection and mixed declarations in generated adapter output; all strengthened tests and fixtures are committed.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: AST-aware TypeScript/Svelte audit rejects mixed named declarations; generators split all scaffold and browser-support output, and inherited guidance documents the same rule.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired green 55b33030be at 172d26636 passes the same 18 audit/scaffold tests from red b480452d8 with all test/fixture/config inputs unchanged.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
